transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm just here because... well, my husband and the people at the warehouse keep acting like I'm crazy. But I'm not. I just... I know they've been watching my moves at work. They keep changing my pallet counts and stuff. They're just doing it to keep me from getting that supervisor spot. That's it.
Have you heard any voices or sounds that other people around you couldn't hear?

I don't know... I mean, sometimes. Just... when I'm in the aisle at work, or even just folding clothes at home. I'll hear this man's voice. He just says, "Nicole, check it again." But... there's nobody around when it happens.
About how long have you been noticing these things happening and hearing this voice?
I guess... maybe around eight months? Yeah, about eight months of the voice and... the stuff at work.
Do you ever feel like thoughts are being put into your head, or taken out of your head against your will?
No... I don't think so. They're just my own thoughts. I don't really know what you mean by that.
Does that voice ever comment on what you are doing as you go about your day?
No... not really. It just... it just says what I told you before. Just to check it again. It doesn't talk about other stuff.
How often do you hear that voice?

Um... just sometimes. Like... if I'm in the aisle at work, or just folding clothes at home. I'll hear it clear as day. It's a man's voice saying, "Nicole, check it again." Even when nobody is anywhere near me.
Do you ever feel like your body, thoughts, or movements are being controlled by someone or something outside of yourself?
No... I don't feel like that. Nobody controls me. It's just me doing my own stuff.
Do you ever feel like the TV, radio, or internet is sending special messages specifically to you?
No... I don't have anything like that happen. It's just regular TV.
